summary: A busy, mostly cooperative week: Kirsten responded warmly to Derrek's Aug 1 infrastructure update, turned around a fan-verification shower video within minutes, resent all of Wesley's anniversary customs after a chat-team handover lost track of them, and paid the corrected $7,705 invoice the same day it was clarified. Friction came from a harassing fan (Moggy/will17489) repeatedly calling her on Snapchat -- she had to chase the team four times over two days before it was resolved by blocking him -- plus a third consecutive invoice needing correction (this time a $159 chargeback) and two of her questions (Meta-support cost split, Monday rollout) going unanswered all week. Mood: engaged and friendly, but with visible flashes of frustration when left waiting on fan-safety issues.

health.rationale: Pays reliably and stays highly cooperative, but needed repeated nudges on a fan-harassment issue, invoices keep needing corrections, and the long-running IG-growth promises are still awaiting delivery.
